about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: The story of three students exploring the software universe.
about.subtitleHighlight: Small team. Big curiosity. Infinite universe.
about.intro: It all started with a single question: "Have you ever imagined having your own website?" The answer was short — "sure." Three software students united around the meaninglessness of keeping knowledge to themselves, and the rest was just following curiosity.
about.missionText: Instead of hoarding what we learn, giving it back in a clear and sincere way. Today, three students write, create, and grow this platform a little more every day. Our goal isn't to shine — it's to be a place that genuinely learns and passes on what it knows.
about.missionQuote: "Knowledge exists not to be stored, but to be shared."
about.visionText1: Some structures repel those around them, others attract. We want to be the latter — a center that slowly gathers everything scattered across the software universe, one that doesn't let go once you get close. Knowledge eventually enters our orbit; we take it in and make it our own. The bigger we grow, the stronger our pull.
about.visionText1Highlight: slowly gathers everything, doesn't let go once you get close
about.visionText2: Today we're three. But on the horizon, we see something bigger: a hub where software students come together, manage their projects, share what they write, connect with each other, and perhaps find their path. We're still a small nucleus — but every center starts small. You too could be drawn into this field.
